templates.why_chosen: Three coloured path overlays over a repeated protocol-stack lane, with the legend below spelling out each path.
templates.what_to_learn: Overlay alternative paths in different colours on one shared substrate rather than drawing the substrate twice; the legend below then reads as a path list.

templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from flanked-core by the note-writer: three matched four-layer stacks (Compute Node, Switch, Memory Node) sit side by side, with the paper's Central Scheduler contribution accent-filled on the switch axis between two mirrored sides, not a core flanked by bands.
templates.what_to_learn: Align identical protocol-stack layers across parallel columns so a reader compares row by row, and put the paper's actual contribution (the scheduler) on the shared axis between the two mirrored sides, accent-filled, rather than folding it into a bottom hardware band.
